note: Inciting incident: Peri envoy binds protagonist and issues the spindle mission, initiating the main plot.
Clarification/reinforcement of the commission: Azraq clarifies the Council's demand and stakes; offers limits on the amulet and names potential counters, raising strategic stakes.
Departure/commitment: Amina accepts the mission under coercion, asserts command and protective terms, and the ship prepares and departs—stakes clarified and plot moves to sea.
Preparation and local lore: supplies gathered, folio and wreck log examined aboard the Qitaf, crew trades sailor-lore about Isle Jarrah; departure preparations continue (departure set for dawn).
Approach/at-sea: departure at first light; Azraq watches from aft and the amulet enforces via thrum; crew consults folio and wreck log; approach to Isle Jarrah and fog begin to close in.
At-sea complication: instrument anomalies and sea-folds force manual seamanship; folio and wreck-log pattern recognition raise stakes; forward hook (flotsam) signals forthcoming incident (s-007).
